Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26502 --file=F --json` run ONCE with the output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage 6434866508 (2026-10-27 05:52Z): **p2**, `documentation`, `domain:skills` (Tier H), `area:workflow` — the `Skills-docs:` follow-up that PR #26501 (#26466) named for this file. The card's 「Wanted」 is the whole scope: (1) one short paragraph beside 「Elevate the write, not the flow」 in `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (today L164–191) stating that a system context's governed writes (insert, update, delete, transfer, restore, purge) to `sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member` are refused `PERMISSION_DENIED`, and the remedy the refusal itself prescribes (grant positions and permission sets from a `runAs: 'user'` flow, judged by the delegated-administration gate as the user it acts for; invitations and memberships through the organization endpoints), linking `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 1b; (2) one eval prompt in `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` (id 11, the file's existing shape): an author asks a system flow to assign a permission set, the ideal answer routes the grant through a `runAs: 'user'` flow. ⛔ Describe the refusal, never a way around it (#9387). ⛔ Never write the word role in skills prose (ADR-0090 D3, `check:role-word`): say permission set / position.

### Scope and tier

File surface: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (the one paragraph; ⛔ not line 1, PR #25640 owns the version stamp) + `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` (eval 11; write the ideal answer so it never contains its own `must_not_contain` strings) + **the two touched rows of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** (L410 `SKILL.md` 6164, L810 the eval file 2427 — both at headroom 0 on `3fcafcd3`) under ruling A (the maintainer's tap 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, seat thread decision card, 2026-10-27 01:21Z; option A verbatim: 「八张卡的 PR 各自削重复后,把所改文件的天花板行提高恰好差额,正文引用你这句;教学和 eval 都落。」): first cut GENUINE restatements inside the two files you touch (each cut names its surviving home in the PR body; none found ⇒ say so), then raise each touched row by exactly the measured remainder — ceil(utf8 bytes / 4), `SKILL.md` minus its 20-byte version line — pinned AT the measurement, the tap quoted verbatim in each row comment and in the PR body. ⛔ No other file, ⛔ no other package's rows, ⛔ not `content/docs/**` (PR #26501 owns the docs half; mirror its wording, do not duplicate it). Tier H (`skills/**` published surface, `dispatch-gates --tier` MANDATORY ceiling, no one-line exit, clause ① 「必须 fable的还包括对外发布的skills」): the PR stays a draft; you never ready, arm, enqueue or approve it (os-dev.md rule 2); if a governed approver does, report it, touch nothing. Tier of your thread: the path mandate above; `effort: high` (XS card, a published teaching paragraph whose wrong word ships to third parties).

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at `3fcafcd3` (seat, 2026-10-27T06:40Z): **holds.**
1. `SKILL.md` L164–191 carry 「Writing a `readonly` field? Set `runAs: 'system'`」, 「the trusted-writer channel」, 「Elevate the write, not the flow」 and 「A `runAs: 'system'` sweep must pin its organization」; no line in the file names `sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member` or the refusal — grep it on your tree to confirm before writing.
2. `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row **1b** (L100) states the rule, who it binds (a flow run's, an app-authored hook's and an action body's system context) and names the implementation (`plugin-security/src/flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts#elevationSource`); the remedy wording is `packages/spec/src/identity/identity-assignment-body-writes.ts` L88–102 — quote its prescription, do not invent a third wording. The eval file holds ids 1–10 (eval 1 already teaches `runAs: 'system'` for a readonly sweep — your eval 11 is the counter-case, not a restatement).
3. Serial: no open PR touches `skills/objectstack-automation/**` (scan at 2026-10-27T06:40Z; #26495 and #26446 on this package are merged, #26501 touches `content/docs/**` only and is still open — read its two pages for the sibling wording). If the queue kicks your PR on a ratchet-row conflict, merge `origin/main` (merge commit, no rebase, no force), keep main's sibling rows, re-run the ratchet gate, push, and post a follow-up report.

### Card-specific clauses

- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; at least `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (+ `--self-test`), `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-top-level-keys`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:role-word` and the skill eval/compat checks green (read `package.json` for exact names); long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26502`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26502` (behind the harness's two attribution lines), then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (Tier H: 需要你做的 = an approver's APPROVED on the draft), then What changes (the paragraph quoted, the eval quoted), the duplicate scan and its result, the ratchet arithmetic per row, Tests, Acceptance notes (the card's two acceptance lines answered), Verification. ⛔ No model name anywhere in commits or PR; the model-free trailer pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them.
- ⛔ Never write the card's labels or assignee. ⛔ No GitHub MCP tools, reads included.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26502 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations` and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 naming the PR number, the head sha, the report comment id and the premise verdict; then stay subscribed to the PR for the contract review's verdict and a possible patch round.
